$comment: Owned, expiring ACCEPTED-RISK windows for the required pip-audit step (issue #277 AC5), keyed by PACKAGE. The gate's first CI run (2026-11-06) surfaced 129 open advisories across these 7 packages in the legacy Python harness's resolution (pypdf 67, pillow 50, chromadb 3, transformers 6, python-jose 1, ecdsa 1, diskcache 1) plus the sentence-transformers critical the audit originally named; the fix versions are semver-major bumps on the legacy harness - an upgrade decision that belongs to the maintainer on audit epic #284, not something this gate may decide by wedging. Every entry names the owner, the owner issue, and an expiry after which the required context goes red and the decision is forced. Per-package (vs the JS gate's per-advisory-id) is the disclosed, deliberate asymmetry for a 129-finding residual.
